*Department: *Early Childhood / Kindergarten

Support the Class Teacher in creating a warm, safe and nurturing Waldorf kindergarten environment. Assist with daily classroom rhythms, child care, creative activities and school programmes while developing teaching skills through observation, mentorship and Year 1 training.

*Classroom support*

Assist the Class Teacher with daily activities, sessions and transitions, including morning circle songs, verses and seasonal movement.

Support wet-on-wet watercolour painting, beeswax modelling, form drawing and seasonal crafts.

Prepare the seasonal and nature tables, art materials and snack setup before school. Keep the classroom tidy, warm and aesthetically aligned with Waldorf principles, and restore order after sessions.

Prepare props, the story corner and puppet setups as directed by the Coordinator.

*Child care and supervision*

Provide attentive, calm supervision during free play, snacks, transitions and outdoor activities. Respond patiently to children’s physical, emotional and social needs.

Build individual connections with every child and address children by name. Offer additional support to children who are shy, new or experiencing separation anxiety.

Allow children to lead their creative play, intervening when safety or wellbeing requires it.

Report wellbeing concerns promptly and confidentially to the Coordinator. Know and follow school emergency and first-aid protocols.

*Observation and Year 1 training*

Keep a regular observation journal covering classroom rhythms, activities, play patterns and personal reflections. Document children’s physical, social, emotional and creative development.

Attend weekly mentorship check-ins with the Class Teacher, prepared with observations and questions.

Attend Waldorf orientation, internal workshops and staff development days. Read recommended early childhood texts and submit a brief monthly reading reflection.

Develop personal artistic skills, including singing, knitting, sewing and beeswax work.

Swadhaa | Kindergarten Teacher |

*Classroom administration and materials*

Mark daily attendance accurately and flag unexplained absences to the Coordinator.

Update the materials inventory monthly and report replenishment needs for paints, beeswax, yarn, natural materials and snack supplies.

Care for classroom resources, including washing brushes, storing beeswax correctly and maintaining fabrics and natural items. Regularly source seasonal leaves, stones, flowers and pods for the nature table.

Assist with parent notices, newsletters and seasonal letters. Obtain the Coordinator’s review before dispatch.

Complete and submit a monthly classroom safety and hygiene checklist to the Coordinator.

*Festivals and school events*

Participate creatively in seasonal celebrations, including Diwali, Advent and Harvest. Help prepare decorations, costumes, food and festival setups.

Support parent evenings, open days, performances and outings. Complete assigned event logistics punctually and reliably.

*Parent interaction*

Greet parents warmly and professionally at drop-off and pick-up, maintaining appropriate communication boundaries.

Refer parent queries, concerns and discussions about children’s development to the Coordinator rather than addressing these independently.

Protect children’s personal information and family circumstances at all times.

*Professional conduct and safeguarding*

Arrive before children, maintain consistent attendance and follow school leave procedures.

Work respectfully with colleagues, staff and volunteers. Reflect Waldorf values in manner, speech and dress.

Avoid personal mobile devices or screens in the classroom or in view of children.

Maintain confidentiality about children, families, staff and school affairs. Do not share school matters on personal social media or with people outside the school community.

Report safeguarding concerns or ethical issues to the Coordinator. If not addressed, escalate immediately to the Academic Head.

*Role requirements and employment details*

This role calls for patience, warmth, careful observation, reliability, confidentiality, teamwork and a willingness to learn Waldorf early childhood practices. · Monitor early developmental milestones and provide timely, targeted remedial interventions.

· Lead parent meetings, workshops, and case conferences with empathy and clarity.

· Collaborate with speech and language therapists, occupational therapists, educational psychologists, and medical professionals to maintain unified care plans.

· *Education*: Bachelor’s degree / Diploma in Education, Early Childhood Education, Special Needs Education, or an equivalent discipline.

1. Job Purpose

To provide effective academic leadership, administrative management, and strategic direction for the overall functioning of a CBSE school from Kindergarten to Grade XII. The Principal will be responsible for academic excellence, student development, staff performance, CBSE compliance, parent engagement, school operations, and the implementation of management policies.

2. Key Roles and Responsibilities

*A. Academic Leadership*

* Lead and monitor the academic activities from KG to Grade XII in accordance with CBSE curriculum guidelines.
* Ensure effective curriculum planning, lesson planning, teaching methodologies, and assessment practices.
* Monitor student academic performance and implement improvement strategies.
* Conduct regular classroom observations, academic reviews, and teacher performance assessments.
* Ensure effective implementation of NEP 2020, competency-based learning, experiential learning, and other applicable CBSE guidelines.
* Coordinate examinations, board exam preparation, academic calendars, and remedial programmes.
* Guide teachers and coordinators in improving teaching quality and learning outcomes.

*B. Staff Management and Leadership*

* Lead, motivate, and supervise teaching and non-teaching staff.
* Coordinate with HR for recruitment, induction, staff deployment, performance appraisal, and professional development.
* Conduct regular staff meetings, performance reviews, and training programmes.
* Ensure staff discipline, punctuality, accountability, and compliance with school policies.
* Develop a collaborative work culture and encourage teamwork, innovation, and professional growth.

*C. School Administration and Operations*

* Oversee the day-to-day functioning of the school, including academics, administration, transport, discipline, infrastructure, and student welfare.
* Ensure proper maintenance of school records, registers, attendance, examination records, and statutory documents.
* Monitor school infrastructure, laboratories, libraries, sports facilities, and other learning resources.
* Coordinate with the Accounts, HR, IT, Transport, and Administration departments for smooth operations.
* Ensure proper implementation of SOPs, institutional policies, and management instructions.
* Review school performance reports, operational expenses, and resource utilization.

*D. CBSE Compliance and Regulatory Requirements*

* Ensure compliance with applicable CBSE affiliation bye-laws, examination guidelines, and academic requirements.
* Monitor the maintenance and timely submission of mandatory records, declarations, and reports.
* Ensure compliance with applicable child protection, student safety, fire safety, health, sanitation, and other statutory requirements.
* Coordinate CBSE inspections, affiliation-related documentation, and official communications.
* Ensure proper implementation of child safeguarding measures and applicable POCSO requirements.

*E. Student Development and Discipline*

* Promote academic excellence, discipline, leadership, creativity, sports, arts, and extracurricular activities.
* Establish a safe, inclusive, and student-friendly learning environment.
* Monitor student attendance, behaviour, emotional well-being, and overall development.
* Address student grievances and disciplinary matters fairly and promptly.
* Encourage life skills, values-based education, critical thinking, and holistic development.

*F. Parent Relations and Community Engagement*

* Maintain positive relationships with parents and address their concerns professionally.
* Conduct parent-teacher meetings and review parent feedback.
* Coordinate with Parent Counsellors and PROs to improve parent satisfaction and school reputation.
* Support admissions, retention, school events, and community engagement initiatives.
* Represent the school at meetings, educational forums, and official events.

*G. Admissions, Growth and Institutional Development*

* Support the admissions team in achieving annual enrolment targets.
* Monitor student retention, parent satisfaction, and overall school performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve academic quality, school visibility, and institutional reputation.
* Develop annual academic and operational plans aligned with management objectives.
* Submit monthly performance reports to the management.

3. Educational Qualifications

* Master’s Degree in Education, preferably M.Ed., or a relevant postgraduate qualification.
* B.Ed. is mandatory or preferred, as applicable to the position and current CBSE requirements.
* Additional qualifications in educational leadership, school administration, or management will be an advantage.

4. Experience Requirements

* *Minimum 10–15 years of experience* in the school education sector.
* Minimum *5 years of experience as a Principal, Vice Principal, or senior academic leader*, with substantial school leadership responsibilities.
* Experience in handling a *CBSE school from Kindergarten to Grade XII* is strongly preferred.
* Proven experience in academic planning, staff management, CBSE compliance, school administration, parent relations, and student development.
* Experience in managing large schools with multiple academic departments and a sizeable teaching and non-teaching workforce will be an advantage.
* Candidates with experience in CBSE affiliation processes and Classes X and XII board examination management will be preferred.

5. Essential Skills and Competencies

* Strong academic leadership and school management capabilities.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and decision-making skills.
* Effective staff supervision, conflict resolution, and team-building abilities.
* Sound knowledge of CBSE curriculum, examination systems, and school compliance requirements.
* Proficiency in school ERP/HRMIS, digital learning platforms, and school management systems.
* Strong parent engagement, problem-solving, and grievance-handling skills.
* Ability to set targets, monitor KPIs, and deliver measurable academic and operational outcomes.
* High integrity, professional discipline, accountability, and a student-first approach.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Principal’s performance will be evaluated based on:

* Student academic performance and board examination results.
* Teaching quality and classroom observation outcomes.
* Student enrolment, retention, and admissions performance.
* Teacher retention, staff discipline, and professional development.
* CBSE compliance and timely submission of mandatory documentation.
* Student safety, discipline, attendance, and well-being.
* Parent satisfaction and grievance resolution.
* Effective implementation of school policies, SOPs, and management decisions.
* School infrastructure, operational efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Achievement of annual institutional goals and continuous improvement targets.

7. Personal Attributes

* Visionary and result-oriented educational leader.
* Approachable, disciplined, and fair in decision-making.
* Capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced school environment.
* Committed to continuous improvement, innovation, and educational excellence.
* Able to work collaboratively with management, teachers, parents, students, and administrative teams.

The roles and responsibilities of a school teacher can vary depending on grade level, subject, and school policies, but here are some common core duties and expectations:

*Instructional Planning*: Teachers are responsible for designing and delivering effective lesson plans that align with curriculum standards. They must adapt their teaching methods to accommodate diverse learning styles and abilities.

*Classroom Management*: Maintaining a positive and orderly classroom environment is crucial. Teachers must establish rules and expectations, manage student behavior, and address any disruptions that may arise.

*Assessment and Evaluation*: Teachers assess student performance through various means such as tests, quizzes, projects, and assignments. They analyze and use assessment data to track student progress and adjust instruction as needed.

*Curriculum Development*: In addition to lesson planning, teachers may have a role in developing or revising curriculum materials to meet the needs of their students and keep up with educational standards.

*Individualized Instruction*: Recognizing that students have different learning needs, teachers should provide additional support or challenges as required. This includes working with students who have special needs or require differentiated instruction.

*Communication*: Teachers communicate regularly with students, parents, and colleagues. They provide feedback on student progress, discuss concerns, and attend parent-teacher conferences and meetings.

*Professional Development*: Continuous learning is essential for teachers. They should engage in ongoing professional development to stay current with educational trends, teaching methods, and subject matter.

*Supervision and Safety*: Ensuring the safety and well-being of students is a top priority. Teachers must supervise students in and outside of the classroom and follow safety protocols.

*Collaboration*: Teachers often work as part of a team, collaborating with other educators, specialists, and support staff to address the diverse needs of their students.

*Counseling and Support*: Teachers sometimes act as mentors and provide emotional support to students who may be facing challenges at home or in their personal lives.

*Record-Keeping*: Maintaining accurate records of student attendance, grades, and other relevant information is essential for monitoring progress and complying with administrative requirements.

*Professional Ethics*: Teachers are expected to adhere to a code of professional ethics, which includes respecting student confidentiality, maintaining appropriate boundaries, and upholding the values of fairness and equity in their teaching practices.

*Community Involvement*: Engaging with the local community and participating in school events, clubs, or extracurricular activities can be part of a teacher's responsibilities.

*Technology Integration*: In today's digital age, teachers are often expected to incorporate technology into their teaching methods and use it for communication and instructional purposes.

*Cultural Sensitivity*: Being aware of and respecting cultural and diversity issues in the classroom is crucial for creating an inclusive learning environment.

* Perform other duties as assigned: TGT teachers may be responsible for other duties as assigned by the school, such as participating in school committees, attending faculty meetings, and serving as a mentor to new teachers.

Overall, a TGT teacher is responsible for providing high-quality education to secondary students, helping them develop the skills and knowledge they need to succeed in their future academic and professional pursuits.

The roles and responsibilities of a school teacher can vary depending on grade level, subject, and school policies, but here are some common core duties and expectations:

*Instructional Planning*: Teachers are responsible for designing and delivering effective lesson plans that align with curriculum standards. They must adapt their teaching methods to accommodate diverse learning styles and abilities.

*Classroom Management*: Maintaining a positive and orderly classroom environment is crucial. Teachers must establish rules and expectations, manage student behavior, and address any disruptions that may arise.

*Assessment and Evaluation*: Teachers assess student performance through various means such as tests, quizzes, projects, and assignments. They analyze and use assessment data to track student progress and adjust instruction as needed.

*Curriculum Development*: In addition to lesson planning, teachers may have a role in developing or revising curriculum materials to meet the needs of their students and keep up with educational standards.

*Individualized Instruction*: Recognizing that students have different learning needs, teachers should provide additional support or challenges as required. This includes working with students who have special needs or require differentiated instruction.

*Communication*: Teachers communicate regularly with students, parents, and colleagues. They provide feedback on student progress, discuss concerns, and attend parent-teacher conferences and meetings.

*Professional Development*: Continuous learning is essential for teachers. They should engage in ongoing professional development to stay current with educational trends, teaching methods, and subject matter.

*Supervision and Safety*: Ensuring the safety and well-being of students is a top priority. Teachers must supervise students in and outside of the classroom and follow safety protocols.

*Collaboration*: Teachers often work as part of a team, collaborating with other educators, specialists, and support staff to address the diverse needs of their students.

*Counseling and Support*: Teachers sometimes act as mentors and provide emotional support to students who may be facing challenges at home or in their personal lives.

*Record-Keeping*: Maintaining accurate records of student attendance, grades, and other relevant information is essential for monitoring progress and complying with administrative requirements.

*Professional Ethics*: Teachers are expected to adhere to a code of professional ethics, which includes respecting student confidentiality, maintaining appropriate boundaries, and upholding the values of fairness and equity in their teaching practices.

*Community Involvement*: Engaging with the local community and participating in school events, clubs, or extracurricular activities can be part of a teacher's responsibilities.

*Technology Integration*: In today's digital age, teachers are often expected to incorporate technology into their teaching methods and use it for communication and instructional purposes.

*Cultural Sensitivity*: Being aware of and respecting cultural and diversity issues in the classroom is crucial for creating an inclusive learning environment.

Customer Training & Enablement

* Create training materials such as workshop decks, teacher guides, video tutorials, hands-on kit guides, quick-start manuals, and FAQs.
* Plan and deliver training in multiple formats: in-person workshops, virtual sessions, and self-paced modules.
* *Build and manage a trainer team* (internal trainers, master trainers, or partners), including training-the-trainer programs and quality standards.
* Schedule and coordinate training across schools, managing logistics, timelines, and resources.
* Track training effectiveness through attendance, feedback scores, teacher confidence, adoption rates, and student outcomes.
* Continuously improve training content using classroom observations and customer feedback.
* Set up support channels (helpdesk, community, office hours) to keep customers successful after training.

*Product & Design Collaboration*

* Work with designers on learning materials, digital platforms, and Makerspace layouts.
* Translate educational goals into clear requirements for the development team.
* Oversee the development of learning tools, platforms, or kits, from prototype to launch.

*Customer & Stakeholder Management*

* Serve as the main contact for schools, administrators, and educators.
* Conduct product demos, pilot programs, and workshops.
* Gather feedback from teachers and students and turn it into program improvements.
* Support Makerspace setup, teacher onboarding, and ongoing training.

Program & Team Leadership

* Plan, manage, and deliver Makerspace and Innovation programs across multiple schools or client accounts.
* *Design and build the program team:* define roles and team structure across Full Stack, Frontend, Backend, design, and curriculum, and plan capacity as programs grow.
* *Lead hiring and onboarding* for developers, designers, curriculum designers, and trainers, working with HR and leadership.
* Lead and coordinate the engineering team, setting sprint goals, timelines, and priorities.
* Run agile ceremonies and keep FE, BE, and design work in sync.
* Set team goals and KPIs, conduct regular performance check-ins, and mentor team members.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous learning.
* Manage program budgets, resources, risks, and delivery milestones.

Required Qualifications

* *Master's degree* (M.Tech, MBA, or equivalent) with a *B.Tech / B.E.* in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* *12+ years of experience* in program or project management, ideally in EdTech, STEM education, or innovation programs, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Proven experience leading and scaling cross-functional teams of Full Stack, Frontend, and Backend developers and designers.
* Experience building and managing teams, including hiring, onboarding, and performance management.
* Working understanding of the software development lifecycle, web application architecture, APIs, and databases, with the ability to discuss technical trade-offs.
* Hands-on experience designing K-12 curriculum, especially for Makerspace, STEM/STEAM, or innovation labs.
* Experience designing and delivering training programs for teachers, educators, or enterprise customers.
* Strong understanding of project-based learning and design thinking.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience delivering product demos, client sessions, and leadership presentations.
* Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools (Jira, Asana, Trello, Figma, GitHub, or similar).

C.N.M. SCHOOL & N. D. PAREKH PRE-PRIMARY SCHOOL was the first English medium school started by SVKM in 1997. It was the dream project of Late Shri Mukeshbhai Patel, since SVKM was running several colleges but had only one vernacular medium school.

His Mission was taken forward by Shri Balwantrai Sheth and Shri Vivek Vaidya. Mrs. Lata Munjal was the first Principal of the institution. Under the valuable guidance and support of Shri Amrishbhai Patel CNM school has achieved great progress in the field of academics and sports.The state of the art infrastructure has been planned and developed under the able guidance of Shri Bhupeshbhai Patel.

The school started with 25 students, 1 teacher and 1 support staff in a small place at Gokhalibai School,Vile Parle on June 1997. The school had only a Junior KG section with Mrs. Cheryl Mukath as their teacher.

The very next year the strength of the school grew to 154 students and by 2005 the strength was 3975 with eight divisions in each standard from nursery to standard Ten. After two years of its inception in 1999 the school got its new building, with the latest amenities for the students. The first batch of ICSE students passed out in 2003 with 22 students.

Mrs. Girija Mohan took over as the Principal from 2006 under whose stewardship, the school grew from strength to strength. In 2015, Mrs. Sangita Kukreti took over and the academics of the school got further cemented with latest technologies and new developments. In 2019, Mrs. Kavita Sanghvi stepped into the role of the Principal and introduced new concepts like ‘STEAM’, ‘Coding’ & ‘Global Outlook’ within the curriculum . Today there are 3131 students, 175 teaching staff, 12 office staff and 20 support staff who run the school with remarkable efficiency and dedication.

The school offers a modern, holistic and integrated system of education that moulds its students into free thinkers who can easily function as global citizens.

Location : Hyderabad / neighbouring districts (Telangana); Chennai/ neighbouring districts (Tamil Nadu); Ahmedabad (Gujarat)

Reports To : Project Coordinator and relevant managers

About Smile Foundation:
Smile Foundation is an Indian development organization working for the welfare of underserved children and their families through intensive programmes focused on education, healthcare, skilling and women empowerment. We work as a catalyst in the cycle of change, complementing and supplementing government efforts, in alignment with the SDGs and ESG. We sensitize and partner with like-minded institutions and individuals to implement high-impact programmes that enable access, enhance quality and help bring long term behavioral change at the grassroots.
Started in 2002 by a group of young corporate professionals, today Smile Foundation has evolved into a national level development organization impacting the lives of over 2 million underserved children and families every year. With a project presence in 27 states across India, 10 offices in strategic locations, and a team of 1000+ employees including more than 150 programme officers, 4000+ onground facilitators from over 250 community-based organizations, besides countless volunteers, wellwishers, and supporters.
Visit our website to know more about us and our latest development: www.smilefoundationindia.org

What’s our vision?
Over the next few years, we are envisioning to scale our impact to reach more vulnerable children and families across India, by inspiring greater social action through a multi-stakeholder approach, involving individuals, businesses, schools, government stakeholders and more. People, technology and data would be at the centre stage of every endeavor of Smile – we wish to establish as a unique organization
in the social development space. We are aiming at deeper and more diverse partnerships and collaborations with the business world in areas including CSR investment, ESG spending, shared value, impact investment, philanthropic partnerships and social stock investment. We will also be working to develop a loyal individual supporter base to strengthen the sustainability of the organization.

Project Overview
Smile Foundation’s Mission Education initiative aims to strengthen STEM learning and innovationmindsets among students in government and government-aided schools through experiential andhands-on learning facilitated via Tinker Labs / STEM Labs for Grades 6–10. This particular project focuses on ‘Activating Atal Tinkering Labs (ATLs) and will support students to develop 21st-century competencies such as problem-solving, creativity, critical thinking, and teamwork.

Role Purpose
The STEM Facilitator will support the implementation and monitoring of STEM and tinkering-basedlearning across assigned schools. The role will involve conducting STEM sessions, supporting student and teacher engagement, facilitating innovation activities, and promoting effective utilisation of ATL/STEM infrastructure.

The incumbent will ensure timely implementation of project activities as per the Project Implementation Plan (PIP) and support regular reporting, documentation, data tracking, and coordination with the Project Coordinator and school-level stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

1. STEM Program Implementation
 Conduct hands-on, project-based, and activity-based STEM sessions in ATL/STEM labs.
 Facilitate STEM, tinkering, innovation, design thinking, and student project activities.
 Guide students in developing projects, prototypes, and participating in innovation challenges.
 Ensure implementation of planned activities as per the PIP and project timelines.
 Support effective utilisation of ATL/STEM labs, equipment, kits, and learning resources.

2. Teacher Support & Capacity Building
 Support teachers in adopting hands-on and experiential STEM learning approaches.
 Demonstrate STEM activities and lab-based teaching practices.
 Support teacher orientations, training sessions, and reflective learning activities.
 Provide regular academic handholding to teachers.

3. Lab Management & Student Engagement
 Support the readiness, upkeep, and effective utilisation of ATL/STEM labs.
 Maintain basic lab, inventory, and usage records.
 Identify and mentor STEM Clubs / Innovation Teams.

4. Monitoring, Reporting & Documentation
 Monitor implementation and progress of project activities across assigned schools.
 Maintain attendance, activity, lab usage, and student participation records.
 Submit regular school visit and activity reports to the Project Coordinator.
 Document student innovations, success stories, case studies, photographs, and other project outcomes.
 Identify implementation challenges and coordinate with the Project Coordinator for timely resolution.

Key Deliverables
 Regular school visits and STEM sessions as per the project plan.
 Effective implementation of planned activities across assigned schools.
 Functional and effectively utilised ATL/STEM labs.
 Active STEM Clubs / Innovation Teams in assigned schools.
 Student participation in STEM and innovation events.
 Timely reporting, documentation, and progress tracking.

Experience & Qualifications-
 Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or related field.
 Preferred: B.Tech/B.Sc. in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Computer Science, Electronics, Mechatronics, or related disciplines.
 1.5–4 years of experience in STEM facilitation, ATL, robotics, science teaching, makerspaces, or related areas.
 Experience working with government school systems will be an added advantage.
 Strong understanding of ATL, STEM concepts and experiential learning.
 Hands-on knowledge of robotics, IoT, coding, electronics, DIY kits, 3D printing, or related area.
 Ability to engage and mentor students and teachers.
 Strong communication, coordination, documentation, and reporting skills.
 Willingness to travel frequently to assigned schools.
 Field-based role with regular visits to assigned schools and ATL/STEM labs.
 Travel across assigned districts/blocks.
 Participation in STEM events, fairs, exhibitions, and other project activities as required.

How to Apply:
Share your CV/Profile with a brief note (cover letter) telling why you find yourself a right fit for the role, on the link-https://smilefoundation.keka.com/careers/jobdetails/89673

Smile Foundation is an Equal Opportunity Employer however women candidates are encouraged to apply.

Please Note: Only shortlisted candidates would be contacted by the Human Resources Team

The roles and responsibilities of a school teacher can vary depending on grade level, subject, and school policies, but here are some common core duties and expectations:

*Instructional Planning*: Teachers are responsible for designing and delivering effective lesson plans that align with curriculum standards. They must adapt their teaching methods to accommodate diverse learning styles and abilities.

*Classroom Management*: Maintaining a positive and orderly classroom environment is crucial. Teachers must establish rules and expectations, manage student behavior, and address any disruptions that may arise.

*Assessment and Evaluation*: Teachers assess student performance through various means such as tests, quizzes, projects, and assignments. They analyze and use assessment data to track student progress and adjust instruction as needed.

*Curriculum Development*: In addition to lesson planning, teachers may have a role in developing or revising curriculum materials to meet the needs of their students and keep up with educational standards.

*Individualized Instruction*: Recognizing that students have different learning needs, teachers should provide additional support or challenges as required. This includes working with students who have special needs or require differentiated instruction.

*Communication*: Teachers communicate regularly with students, parents, and colleagues. They provide feedback on student progress, discuss concerns, and attend parent-teacher conferences and meetings.

*Professional Development*: Continuous learning is essential for teachers. They should engage in ongoing professional development to stay current with educational trends, teaching methods, and subject matter.

*Supervision and Safety*: Ensuring the safety and well-being of students is a top priority. Teachers must supervise students in and outside of the classroom and follow safety protocols.

*Collaboration*: Teachers often work as part of a team, collaborating with other educators, specialists, and support staff to address the diverse needs of their students.

*Counseling and Support*: Teachers sometimes act as mentors and provide emotional support to students who may be facing challenges at home or in their personal lives.

*Record-Keeping*: Maintaining accurate records of student attendance, grades, and other relevant information is essential for monitoring progress and complying with administrative requirements.

*Professional Ethics*: Teachers are expected to adhere to a code of professional ethics, which includes respecting student confidentiality, maintaining appropriate boundaries, and upholding the values of fairness and equity in their teaching practices.

*Community Involvement*: Engaging with the local community and participating in school events, clubs, or extracurricular activities can be part of a teacher's responsibilities.

*Technology Integration*: In today's digital age, teachers are often expected to incorporate technology into their teaching methods and use it for communication and instructional purposes.

*Cultural Sensitivity*: Being aware of and respecting cultural and diversity issues in the classroom is crucial for creating an inclusive learning environment.

₹*Job Description: PRT Maths Teacher*

*We are looking for a well experineced maths teacher for our reputed schools situated in Manikonda, Hyderabad, affillated with State Board.*

*Job Summary*

A *PRT (Primary Teacher) Maths* outlines the responsibility of teaching mathematics to primary school students (typically Classes 1 to 5) in line with school curricula such as SSC,CBSE or ICSE.

*Job Purpose*To create an engaging, child-centered, and supportive learning environment that builds strong foundational numeracy, logical reasoning, and problem-solving skills in young learners.

*Key Responsibilities*

* *Lesson Planning & Delivery:* Plan and deliver age-appropriate, activity-based, and experiential mathematics lessons aligned with the school curriculum.
* *Core Concept Building:* Teach fundamental topics including number sense, basic operations, fractions, geometry, measurement, time, and money.
* *Interactive Teaching:* Use real-life examples, manipulatives, and digital tools to make abstract mathematical concepts simple and relatable.
* *Assessment & Evaluation:* Design quizzes, classwork, homework, and term assessments; grade papers and track student progress.
* *Support for Learners:* Identify slow learners or students needing extra help and provide remedial or individualized guidance.
* *Classroom Management:* Maintain discipline, order, and a positive, inclusive atmosphere during lessons and recess supervision.

*1. Role Overview*

Responsible for the academic planning, teacher supervision, student development, parent coordination, safety, and day-to-day functioning of the Pre-Primary Section, ensuring age-appropriate learning and smooth school operations.

*A. Academic Planning and Curriculum*

*D. Parent Coordination*

* Conduct parent-teacher meetings and communicate student progress, developmental concerns, and classroom-related updates.
* Address parent queries, document concerns, coordinate resolutions, and escalate sensitive matters to school leadership.
* Ensure timely communication regarding activities, events, student progress, and school requirements.

*E. School Operations and Events*

* Ensure classrooms, teaching materials, learning resources, and activity areas are prepared and maintained.
* Coordinate daily schedules, student attendance, staff deployment, and operational requirements with relevant departments.
* Plan and supervise pre-primary events, celebrations, assemblies, and educational activities, ensuring timely preparation and student safety.
* Coordinate with HR, Admissions, Administration, and other departments for smooth functioning of the section.

*F. Documentation and Reporting*

* Maintain curriculum records, lesson plans, student attendance, developmental reports, classroom observation records, and parent communication records.
* Submit periodic academic and operational reports to the Principal / School Director.
* Monitor pending tasks, ensure completion within assigned timelines, and implement corrective actions wherever required.

*3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)*

* Timely curriculum planning and completion.
* Quality of classroom teaching and student learning outcomes.
* Teacher performance, attendance, and completion of assigned responsibilities.
* Timely student assessments and progress reporting.
* Compliance with student safety and safeguarding procedures.
* Timely resolution of parent concerns.
* Completion of academic documentation and operational tasks within deadlines.

*4. Qualifications and Experience*

* Graduate or postgraduate qualification in Education, Early Childhood Education, or a relevant discipline.
* B.Ed., ECCEd, NTT, or equivalent relevant qualification, as applicable.
* Prior experience in pre-primary teaching and preferably in an academic leadership role.
* Understanding of early childhood development, curriculum planning, classroom management, and parent communication.
* Familiarity with the Cambridge Early Years framework, wherever applicable.

*5. Key Competencies*

* Academic leadership and team management.
* Effective communication and parent relationship management.
* Strong planning, organisation, and follow-up skills.
* Classroom observation and teacher mentoring.
* Student safety awareness, patience, empathy, and professional integrity.

*6. Accountability*

The Headmistress shall be accountable for the academic quality, teacher performance, student development, safety, parent coordination, and day-to-day functioning of the Pre-Primary Section, in accordance with school policies, delegated authority, and management expectations.

*Evercrest International School, Hyderabad*

*Position:* Principal
*Institution:* Evercrest International School
*Location:* Hyderabad, Telangana
*School Board:* CBSE
*Medium of Instruction:* English
*Salary Range:* ₹6,00,000–₹7,20,000 per annum (negotiable for the right candidate)

About Evercrest International School

Evercrest International School is an upcoming CBSE school that aspires to combine academic excellence with an international approach to education. We are committed to nurturing confident, creative, compassionate, and capable learners through innovative teaching methodologies, holistic development, and a vibrant learning environment.

We are looking for a *dynamic, energetic, visionary, and experienced Principal* who can lead the institution with confidence, strengthen academic standards, inspire teachers, and establish a strong culture of discipline, innovation, and excellence.

Role Overview

The Principal will be the *academic and administrative head of the institution*, responsible for the overall management, development, and effective functioning of the school. The ideal candidate must possess strong leadership abilities, excellent communication skills, sound academic knowledge, and the energy and commitment required to build and lead a progressive educational institution.

We welcome experienced educational leaders who are passionate about school development, teacher mentoring, student welfare, and delivering high-quality education.

Key Responsibilities

*1. Academic Leadership*

* Lead the academic vision, planning, and implementation of the CBSE curriculum.
* Ensure high standards of teaching, learning, assessment, and student performance.
* Introduce innovative, student-centred teaching practices and appropriate educational technologies.
* Monitor lesson planning, classroom instruction, academic progress, and learning outcomes.
* Promote holistic development through academics, sports, arts, communication, technology, and life skills.

*2. School Administration and Operations*

* Oversee the day-to-day functioning of the school and ensure smooth administrative operations.
* Establish effective systems, policies, procedures, and reporting mechanisms.
* Ensure compliance with CBSE guidelines, school policies, and applicable educational regulations.
* Maintain a safe, disciplined, organised, and student-friendly campus.
* Coordinate with the management on institutional planning, development, and performance.

*3. Staff Management and Development*

* Lead, motivate, mentor, and supervise teachers and non-teaching staff.
* Support teacher recruitment, induction, training, and professional development.
* Conduct performance reviews and promote accountability and teamwork.
* Build a positive, collaborative, and high-performance working culture.
* Identify training needs and encourage continuous professional improvement.

*4. Student Welfare and Discipline*

* Establish clear standards for student behaviour, attendance, and discipline.
* Promote emotional well-being, inclusion, student safety, and positive relationships.
* Encourage leadership, creativity, critical thinking, and independent learning.
* Ensure effective systems for addressing student concerns and supporting individual learning needs.

*5. Parent Relations and Community Engagement*

* Build strong, transparent, and professional relationships with parents.
* Address parent concerns promptly and constructively.
* Represent the school at meetings, events, and community engagements.
* Work closely with the admissions team to communicate the school's educational philosophy and standards.

*6. Institutional Growth and Development*

* Work closely with the management to establish the school's identity, reputation, and long-term vision.
* Contribute to admissions growth, parent satisfaction, and student retention.
* Implement quality-improvement initiatives and monitor institutional performance.
* Encourage the integration of technology, experiential learning, and international educational practices.
* Help establish Evercrest International School as a trusted and respected educational institution.

Eligibility and Qualifications

* A *Master's degree in Education or a relevant academic discipline*.
* A *B.Ed. degree is mandatory*.
* Substantial experience in school education, preferably in a senior academic leadership or school administration role.
* Experience as a Principal, Vice Principal, Head of School, or senior academic coordinator will be an advantage.
* A strong understanding of the CBSE curriculum, academic planning, school administration, and educational regulations.
* Excellent English communication, interpersonal, organisational, and decision-making skills.
* A demonstrated ability to lead teams, manage institutional responsibilities, and drive academic improvement.

Desired Candidate Profile

We are seeking a candidate who is:

* *Dynamic and energetic:* Proactive, enthusiastic, and capable of leading a growing institution.
* *Strong and decisive:* Confident in decision-making, discipline management, and staff leadership.
* *Academically sound:* Committed to educational excellence and effective teaching practices.
* *Visionary and innovative:* Open to progressive educational approaches and the meaningful use of technology.
* *An excellent communicator:* Fluent in English, with the ability to communicate professionally with students, parents, teachers, and management.
* *People-oriented:* Approachable, empathetic, fair, and capable of inspiring confidence.
* *Results-driven:* Focused on measurable academic improvement, staff performance, student development, and institutional growth.
* *Committed and hands-on:* Willing to take an active role in the day-to-day functioning and development of the school.

Compensation

The indicative annual compensation is *₹6,00,000 to ₹7,20,000*, depending on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and suitability for the role.

*Salary will not be a constraint for the right candidate.* Exceptional candidates who demonstrate strong leadership, relevant experience, energy, and the ability to build and lead the institution can expect a mutually agreeable compensation package based on their profile and the value they bring to the school.

How to Apply

Interested and eligible candidates are invited to submit their updated resume, highlighting their educational qualifications, professional experience, leadership responsibilities, and key achievements in school education.

We look forward to meeting an accomplished and passionate educational leader who can help shape the future of Evercrest International School.

*Evercrest International School*
_Creative. Compassionate. Capable._
